purpose: Define a truthful optimization target for the minimum persistent capability information after parameter/knowledge obsolescence without hiding base dependencies, runtime cost, or evidence bytes.

core_quantities.evidence_bytes: B_PROOF=HISTORICAL_RECEIPTS_LOGS_AND_ARCHIVES; REPORT SEPARATELY; DO_NOT COUNT AS OPERATIVE CAPABILITY UNLESS RUNTIME_LOAD_BEARING

dependency_accounting.adapter_rule: AN_ADAPTER_IS_NOT ITS ADVERTISED FILE SIZE; COUNT ALL CAPABILITY_BEARING_BASES_OR DECLARE THEM AS FIXED GENERAL SUBSTRATE AND DISCLOSE THEM
dependency_accounting.interpreter_rule: MAY_BE_EXCLUDED_ONLY AS EXPLICIT_FIXED_GENERAL_COMPUTATION_SUBSTRATE; EXCLUSION MUST BE DISCLOSED; REPORT CONDITIONAL AND TOTAL/DEPENDENCY VIEW SEPARATELY
dependency_accounting.package_metadata_docs_tests: EXCLUDE_FROM OPERATIVE BYTES WHEN NOT RUNTIME_LOAD_BEARING; RETAIN UNDER PROVENANCE/EVIDENCE ACCOUNTING AS REQUIRED

resource_bounded_objective.reason: Raw shortest-description optimization is pathological because a tiny description may regenerate or search an enormous capability with unacceptable time/compute.

optimization_model.global_mechanism_cover: CHOOSE A VERIFIED SET OF MECHANISMS WHOSE UNION COVERS ALL REQUIRED ATOMIC BEHAVIORS WHILE MINIMIZING UNIQUE DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE_BYTES SUBJECT TO RESOURCE CONSTRAINTS
optimization_model.joint_factorization: OPTIMIZE SHARED_SUBSTRATE_PLUS_CAPABILITY_SPECIFIC_RESIDUALS; DO_NOT MINIMIZE EACH FAMILY IN ISOLATION
optimization_model.elicitation_before_teaching: FIRST TEST WHETHER THE TARGET BEHAVIOR IS ALREADY LATENT IN AN OWNED SHARED SUBSTRATE AND REQUIRES ONLY SMALL CONTROL INFORMATION; TEACH/RETAIN NEW LEARNED INFORMATION ONLY AFTER THAT ROUTE FAILS
optimization_model.counterexample_guided_minimization: START_WITH THE SMALLEST CANDIDATE; ON VERIFIED FAILURE ADD ONLY THE MECHANISM NEEDED TO CLOSE THE COUNTEREXAMPLE; RE-MINIMIZE THE WHOLE CLOSURE; KEEP FINAL QUALIFICATION UNTOUCHED
optimization_model.top_down_and_bottom_up_race: RACE DONOR_DELETION_FROM_ABOVE AGAINST ZERO_BYTE_OR_SMALL_CONSTRUCTION_FROM_BELOW; ACCEPT THE LOWEST-COST VERIFIED ROUTE

minimality_claim_levels.CERTIFIED_LOCAL_OR_REPRESENTATION_CLASS_: ALLOWED WHEN THE SEARCH ENVELOPE AND LOWER_BOUND ARE EXPLICIT

promotion_and_accounting_guards: NO HIDDEN DONOR OR BASE MODEL
NO GENERIC_SMALL_COGNITION_KERNEL ASSUMPTION; SHARING MUST BE EMPIRICAL

relationship_to_existing_bytes_frontiers.rule: THESE ARE DIFFERENT DECLARED CONTRACTS/BOUNDARIES; COMPARE ONLY AFTER NORMALIZING SCOPE, SUBSTRATE, DECODER, TRANSIENT_INFORMATION, AND RESOURCE_ACCOUNTING.
